notes.title: Solution to rendering (objects going too fast or lights turned off) problems
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
I noticed some of you had problems with the game, I made some test and found out how to avoid an horrible gameplay (as if it wasn't hard enough). 

Here is the graphic parameter you need to put to play correctly : 

SCREEN RESOLUTION : 1920x1080*
GRAPHICS QUALITY : fantastic** 

Thanks for playing and enjoy

*Screen resolution doesn't affect as much as the graphics quality but it's better to go full HD
**If this is a problem for your computer, put at least "good"
